NDT software in Deer Park: refinery, chemical plants and tank terminals

NDT software for Deer Park inspection companies has to handle a mix you do not see in many places: a large refinery, chemical plants, and one of the densest clusters of bulk liquid storage terminals on the Gulf Coast. The Atlantis ERP solution gives a Deer Park NDT company one system for technician certifications, instrument calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quotes and invoices, set up around tank, piping and plant work.

The PEMEX Deer Park refinery, formerly Shell Deer Park and fully owned by PEMEX since 2022, sits on the Houston Ship Channel and recently completed a major planned maintenance overhaul. Shell continues to run chemical operations next door. Along Tidal Road, Independence Parkway and the Battleground Road corridor sit specialty chemical plants and a long row of storage terminals handling crude, refined products and chemicals. The March 2019 tank farm fire at the Intercontinental Terminals Company site in Deer Park is still a reference point locally for how much attention storage tanks get.

OSHA process safety management drives mechanical integrity at the refinery and chemical plants, TCEQ monitors emissions events, and the U.S. Chemical Safety Board has investigated incidents in the area, including a hydrogen sulfide release at the refinery. For an NDT contractor, that means site safety orientation, H2S awareness and permit discipline are part of every job. Typical Deer Park contractors run a mix of short, quick-turn terminal jobs and plant turnaround work, with peaks in spring and fall and hurricane season from June through November shifting schedules.

ERP for NDT companies in Deer Park: many short jobs, one clean record

An ERP for NDT companies in Deer Park needs to cope with volume. Terminal work tends to be many small jobs: a floor scan here, a shell thickness survey there, a coating holiday test before a tank goes back into service. Each needs a quote, a crew, calibrated instruments, a report and an invoice. In spreadsheets, that volume is where jobs go unbilled and reports go out late.

The Atlantis ERP links every step. A quotation accepted online becomes a sales order and a project with client PO, site, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria. The team assignment on that project checks technician and equipment availability. Timesheets and reports are logged against the same job, and the invoice pulls labour, equipment and consumables subtotals from them.

For a Deer Park company running dozens of terminal jobs a month, this is mostly about not losing things: not losing the report, not losing the standby hours, and not losing track of which gauge went to which tank. See all apps at Atlantis ERP apps.

NDT reporting software for Deer Park tank terminals

NDT reporting software for tank terminals has to cover floor scanning, shell thickness, coatings and welds. The NDT Reports app includes MFL reports with scan mode and item lines, UT thickness reports with readings by direction, holiday and coating reports, VT, MT and PT for welds and nozzles, and UT with a probe calibration table.

A typical out-of-service tank inspection in Deer Park produces several reports at once: MFL floor scan results, UT thickness on the shell courses and roof, VT of the annular plate and welds, and a holiday test on the internal lining. Each report type has its own numbering sequence, so they stay traceable. Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation, and every report ends with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Reports carry work order, request, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard references, and move through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures. Terminal operators often want reports in their own format, so versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML are built during implementation. If your client also needs API 653 tank inspection services, Atlantis offers those separately through inspection services. The ERP holds the NDT reports; engineering evaluation is outside its scope.

Technician certification tracking for Deer Park plant and terminal crews

Technician certification tracking software for Deer Park has to show quickly which techs can go where. The Certificates app records scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, OJT hours, training hours, exam passed and attachments.

Status is calculated automatically as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, and configurable email alerts go to the operations manager and Level III. Vision tests record near vision, far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry.

In Deer Park, an MFL floor-scan tech, a coatings holiday tester and a refinery PAUT tech may all be on the schedule on the same day. Each needs the right method certification, and some terminal and plant sites also ask for current site orientation and medical fitness. The employee NDT profile stores highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, so the dispatcher checks one screen before sending a crew. Timesheets warn if a technician's certificate is not valid for the day they are logging.

Crew dispatch software for Deer Park: permits, H2S and short notice

Crew dispatch software for Deer Park needs to handle short-notice terminal calls alongside planned plant work. The Team Assignments app runs jobs through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates.

Technicians and equipment serials cannot be double-booked, overlapping availability entries are blocked, and an out-of-calibration instrument raises a warning before the crew leaves. Calendar, kanban and list views show who is where, with utilisation and next available date for each tech.

The project record includes safety induction and work permit fields. In Deer Park that matters: a refinery job may need site-specific orientation and H2S awareness before entry, while a terminal may need confined space entry permits for internal tank work. Recording those requirements on the project means the dispatcher does not send someone who cannot get through the gate. When a storm is forecast, the calendar view shows which crews are committed and which can be released or moved.

Calibration management software for MFL scanners, gauges and holiday testers

Calibration management software for Deer Park companies has to cover specialised terminal equipment as well as standard flaw detectors. The Asset Management app tracks each MFL floor scanner, thickness gauge, UT flaw detector, holiday detector, yoke and probe by serial number, with condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited lab flag, result and next due date. The certificate register tracks lab accreditation numbers and PDFs with valid, expiring or expired status and alerts. The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, repairs, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacements, with condition before and after, which is useful for floor scanners that take a beating on corroded tank bottoms.

Consumables are a real cost on terminal work: couplant, penetrant, developer, cleaner, PPE and coatings test supplies. The consumables ledger tracks movements with reorder levels and low-stock flags, so crews are not held up waiting for supplies. Issue and return requires supervisor and manager approval, and condition is recorded at both ends.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Deer Park terminal and plant work

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Deer Park needs to turn many small quotes into invoices quickly. The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, flags each service by NDT method and category, supports a global discount and produces a branded PDF that the client can accept and sign online, converting straight to a sales order.

The Invoicing app shows the NDT project, job or PO number, site and invoice type on the header, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals. Each line carries cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup time with billable flags and rate multipliers, so the hours a crew spent waiting for a permit are on the invoice if your contract allows it.

Field expenses and per diems logged in Expenses can be re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months, which helps you see whether terminal work or plant work is paying better.

Inspection management software for Deer Park: procedures and NCR/CAPA

Inspection management software for Deer Park companies should keep written procedures audit-ready. The Procedures app stores document number, revision, method (including MFL-related work under ET, UT, VT and others), scope, material, applicable standard, acceptance criteria and text or file.

Procedures move through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with locked approved revisions and a snapshot of every revision. Approvers get email notifications and reminders. An AI-assisted first draft helps your Level III write a new procedure, for example for a new floor scanner model, and the Level III still reviews and approves it.

NCR and CAPA workflows can be configured during implementation, so a client complaint about a report or a site safety observation becomes a tracked action. Company certifications such as ISO accreditations are recorded with alert days. The dashboards show certs expiring, calibrations due and equipment overdue for return in one view.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Deer Park: implementation

An affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Deer Park is one that goes live without stopping your terminal work. Atlantis NDT is led by an ASNT NDT Level III, and implementation is planned around your busy periods.

  • Review: your methods, terminal and plant clients, report formats and billing structure.
  • Import: technicians, certifications, vision tests, instruments, calibration certificates, consumables and open jobs.
  • Templates: MFL, UT thickness and holiday test report layouts to match what your clients receive today, plus quotation and invoice layouts.
  • Integrations: the open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.
  • Training and go-live: office, dispatch and field staff trained on the apps they use.

Pricing is a quote on request. Book a Deer Park NDT ERP demo and bring a recent tank job so we can show it end to end.

Frequently asked questions

What NDT software suits tank terminal inspection in Deer Park?

Software that handles MFL, UT thickness, holiday testing and VT reports alongside dispatch and billing. The Atlantis ERP includes all of these report types in one system.

Does the Atlantis ERP perform API 653 engineering calculations?

No. The ERP holds NDT reports, certifications, calibration and billing. API 653 tank inspection services are offered separately by Atlantis through its inspection services team.

Can we record site orientation and permit requirements?

Yes. Projects include safety induction and work permit fields so dispatchers can check requirements before assigning crews.

Is it affordable for a small Deer Park NDT company?

Yes. It is built to be affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with pricing as a quote on request.

Does the field app work inside a tank or plant with no signal?

Yes. The offline app stores drafts and photos on the device and syncs later.

How do we arrange a demo?

Contact us and we will set up a demo using your own methods and a recent job.
